decision_conditions: A replacement tree  shall be planted in accordance with the following specifications: Tree Species: Birch, Alder or Field Maple .Quantity: x1 .Size/Height: 12-14cm stem circumference at 1m, to be planted in accordance with the recommendations in British Standard 8545:  Trees from nursery to independence in the landscape - Recommendations (2014). Root ball or container grown is acceptable.Location: In the same position as the original tree, or in an alternative position to be agreed in writing by the Council.Deadline: Within 60 days following the removal of the original tree, or an alternative date to be agreed in writing by the Council.The tree shall thereafter be maintained and not removed without the written consent of the Council.
